name: Intake Medicals
description: Five optional checks around the medical. None of them costs anything mechanical.

outcomes.criticalSuccess: Two staff, low: "...the pilot, Nozomi, still hasn't turned up..." Then they see the candidates and stop.
outcomes.success: "...still hasn't turned up." "...keep looking." Somebody is missing, and it matters.
outcomes.criticalFailure: They're sure it's about a missing delivery of forms, and they'll repeat it to anyone who asks.

outcomes.criticalSuccess: Shucks Mordant: one of the four founders. Half the city is named after them, and this one is the real thing, taking blood.
outcomes.success: Mordant: one of the four founders' names. Half the city is named after them.
outcomes.criticalFailure: They're sure it's a brand of disinfectant.

outcomes.criticalSuccess: A half-beat of lag in his right hand, as if something else is deciding. He notices them noticing, and flexes the fingers once.
outcomes.success: His right hand isn't bone. The give at the knuckle is wrong: it's a prosthetic.
outcomes.failure: Nothing they can put a finger on.
outcomes.criticalFailure: They decide it's just what being a skeleton looks like.

outcomes.criticalSuccess: "It's a screen. Screens flag things. You're fine." Then, quieter: "Ask me again in a year if it still bothers you."
outcomes.success: "It's a screen. Screens flag things. You're fine." As far as he's allowed to say, it's true.
outcomes.failure: He answers a different question, kindly.
outcomes.criticalFailure: He decides they're a worrier and books them a welfare check-in nobody wants.

checks.name: Work out what the screen tests

outcomes.criticalSuccess: No standard screen has a result called irregular. This is a custom test for something inherited, which is what a maiden-name box on a medical form is for.
outcomes.success: It's a custom test, not a standard screen.
outcomes.failure: A blood test is a blood test.
outcomes.criticalFailure: They're certain it's an anaemia screen.

notes: No check gates the scene. The flag, the cards and the all-six moment happen whatever anyone rolls. The four knowledge and perception checks are rolled blind: a critical failure is a belief, and the player mustn't see that it's wrong.
